subject.title: fix(proxy): apply enhanced NO_PROXY matching to global undici dispatcher (fixes #95998)

question: Should OpenClaw accept preserving standard NO_PROXY values in managed proxy mode plus a default-off enhanced NO_PROXY global-dispatcher bypass after the reset and docs defects are fixed?
rationale: The remaining code/docs repairs are mechanical, but deciding whether operator-managed proxy mode may honor destination bypasses changes the security and audit boundary.

options.title: Accept after repairs
options.body: Keep the default-off enhanced mode and preserved NO_PROXY behavior after the PR reliably resets omitted config to false and documents the managed-proxy bypass contract.

options.title: Narrow the fix
options.body: Reject the managed-proxy NO_PROXY policy change and require a smaller env-dispatcher fix for the qqbot/COS regression.

options.title: Pause for proxy policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the permanent managed-proxy bypass policy in a separate security/design review.

recommendation.title: Accept after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off enhanced mode and preserved NO_PROXY behavior after the PR reliably resets omitted config to false and documents the managed-proxy bypass contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent `matchesNoProxy` helper work makes this the best available owner for the enhanced-bypass policy choice.
